title: Jaggedswine Farm
wikitext:
[[Image:Jaggedswine_Farm.jpg|thumb|Jaggedswine Farm]]
'''Jaggedswine Farm''' is one of several [[pig farm]]s located in the [[orcish]] homeland of [[Durotar]]. There is a house, a large pig pen, and a pond. The swine is a source of food for the [[Horde]]. The farm is close to the [[Zepplin]] tower and the capital city [[Orgrimmar]]. Currently there is no one at the farm, it is either vacant/abandoned or the owner is in the city doing business.
